description:
Update app — Updates writable fields on an app. PATCH semantics — any subset of `name`, `display_name`, `runtime`, `entry_point` may be sent. `display_name` is the optional free-form UI label; send `null` to clear it and fall back to `name`. An empty body is rejected with 400.

Returns 409 `duplicate_app_name` if renaming would collide with another app in the same tenant.
name: update_app
